I answered Pree in your DM with them. I told them Dock 14 is now noted as their dock for Tansley Parcel pickups on the Larchmont project, and that the note stays private to them.

I didn't save the fact to gbrain myself. gbrain stores each DM automatically and only shows it to that member. Its manual save tool didn't clearly let me keep the fact private, so saving it that way could have made it visible to other people. Nothing else was needed.
